تستأهلون (form X)
# تَسْتَأْهِلُونَ (tastaʔhilūna) /tas.taʔ.hi.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأْهَلَ (istaʔhala)
# تُسْتَأْهَلُونَ (tustaʔhalūna) /tus.taʔ.ha.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَأْهَلَ (istaʔhala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
